title: Nangoku Shounen Papuwa-kun - Gunma Mountain (Exterior)
description:
A beautiful nightly and cozy field seen in the second level of Nangoku Shounen Papuwa-kun.

It's a very large background, meaning it can be used in levels with vertical scrolling enabled or you can just use the lower portion.

A good fit for mountain levels, in general.
